newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed paralysed by settlement deadlock.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed paralysed by settlement deadlock.

text.p: Castorseed March delivery remained untraded for a sixth consecutive day amid on-going deadlock regarding settlement of dues by bull operators wrongfooted by a slump in the market last week, floor sources said.
Since Saturday no trading has taken place on account of the payment problems, they said.
"We are doing our best to solve the deadlock and we have already declared one operator as defaulter," Navin Chandra Shah, President of Bombay Oil Exchange, said.
"I am expecting trading to resume soon," he added.
Meanwhile groundnut oil rose by two to three rupees to 344/345 rupees per 10 Kg amid thin arrivals of 40-50 tonnes coupled with fresh physical support.

Imported palm oil was steady at 282/284 rupees per 10 Kg amid limited arrivals at Bombay Port while offtake was slow. In Rajkot, spot groundnut oil rose by four to five rupees to 519/520 per 15 Kg. --Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
